content:
From the odd condition:
\[
f(-2x-1)=-f(2x-1)
\]
Let \(u=2x-1\), so
\[
f(-u-2)=-f(u)
\]
Using the even condition \(f(t)=f(2-t)\):
\[
f(-u-2)=f(u+4)
\]
Thus
\[
f(u+4)=-f(u)
\]
so
\[
f(u+8)=f(u)
\]
Therefore \(f\) has period \(8\).

Since \(194 \equiv 2 \pmod 8\),
\[
f(194)=f(2)
\]
By evenness,
\[
f(2)=f(0)=e^0=1
\]

\[
\boxed{1}
\]
